port.description: UDP port on which to listen for incoming NetFlow/sFlow/IPFIX flows

host.description: IP address to bind to; use 0.0.0.0 to listen on all interfaces

base_dir.description: Root directory where flow files are stored

subdir.description: Subdirectory under base_dir for live flow files

retention.description: How long to retain flow files (seconds) before deletion

compress_after.description: Seconds after which to auto-compress completed flow files (0 = disable)

flush_interval.description: Seconds to force buffer flush (0 = kernel default)

pipe_program.description: Command to pipe live flows into for real-time processing (e.g., 'nfreplay -h 10.0.0.5:2055')

user.description: System user to drop privileges to after startup

group.description: System group to drop privileges to after startup

extended.description: Enable extended record format for NetFlow v9/IPFIX headers

ipv6.description: Enable IPv6 flow support (required for IPv6 flows)

loglevel.description: Verbosity of logging; choose from: debug, info, notice, warning, error, critical

logfile.description: Log file path; '-' means standard error (or use '/var/log/nfcapd.log')

pidfile.description: Create a PID file to enable safe restarts and monitoring

accept_versions.description: List of NetFlow versions to accept (5=Legacy, 9=NetFlow v9, 10=IPFIX)

bgp.description: Enable BGP daemon integration (adds AS, next-hop, and community metadata)

formats.description: Output formats; 'nfcapd' for standard flow files, 'nfstat' for stats, 'nffile' for raw binary

ssl.description: Enable SSL/TLS encryption for IPFIX-TLS collectors

ssl_cert.description: Path to SSL certificate (required if SSL enabled)

ssl_key.description: Path to SSL private key (required if SSL enabled)

ssl_ca_cert.description: Path to CA certificate for verifying remote collector (optional)

no_padding.description: Disable NetFlow v5 header padding (fixes compatibility with broken exporters)

idle_timeout.description: Idle timeout for flow records (seconds); used for IPFIX session tracking

active_timeout.description: Active flow timeout (seconds) — flow ends after this duration

read_buffer.description: Size of UDP read buffer in bytes (min 1472 for standard MTU)

max_open_files.description: Maximum number of concurrently open flow files

no_dns.description: Disable DNS lookups on IP addresses (improves performance)

cpu_affinity.description: CPU core IDs to bind process to (e.g., [0, 1]); empty = no affinity

nanoseconds.description: Use nanosecond timestamp resolution (requires hardware support)

sample_infer.description: Infer flow sampling rates from sFlow header (essential for accurate traffic stats)

no_coalesce.description: Disable coalescing of similar flows into single records

forward.description: List of collectors to forward flows to; each has host, port, and optional proto

host.description: Hostname or IP of forward target
